verdict.rationale: Recurring work is implied for connector syncs: they run as Kubernetes CronJobs, the Management API manages syncs, and alerts fire when Connector Sync tasks or warehouse batch jobs fail or recover. Nothing shows user-defined schedules or recurring execution of general workflows such as Functions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configuring sync schedules or intervals, scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows (e.g., scheduled Functions), evidence that agents can set schedules via the MCP server or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
